name: no-unchecked-view
code: annalist/read.py extract_chapter builds the prompt from kb instead of with_unchecked(kb, pending), so chapter N is read without chapter N-1

name: no-deepcopy
code: annalist/read.py with_unchecked applies the unchecked extraction to kb itself instead of to copy.deepcopy(kb)
edits:
/\ out' = [ver |-> ver + 1, saw |-> View]
    /\ pc' = "afterExtract"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, mem, n, end, pending, stopN, faults, faulted>>

/\ out' = [ver |-> ver + 1, saw |-> View]
    /\ pc' = "afterExtract"
    /\ mem' = View
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, n, end, pending, stopN, faults, faulted>>

name: gap-check-ignores-pending
code: annalist/read.py cmd_read line 68 drops `and not (pending and pending["n"] == n - 1)`, so the chapter after a pending one looks out of order

name: skip-failed-check
code: annalist/read.py cmd_read catches a failed save_checked(pending) and moves on to the next chapter instead of calling stop_reading
edits:
/\ pc = "afterExtract" /\ pending # None /\ pending.check = "failed"
    /\ pc' = "stop" /\ stopN' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, mem, n, end, out, pending, ver, faults, faulted>>

/\ pc = "afterExtract" /\ pending # None /\ pending.check = "failed"
    /\ pending' = [n |-> n, ver |-> out.ver, saw |-> out.saw, check |-> "running"]
    /\ n' = n + 1 /\ pc' = "top"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, mem, end, out, stopN, ver, faults, faulted>>

name: no-final-save
code: annalist/read.py cmd_read drops the `if pending: save_checked(...)` after the loop (lines 82-86), so the last chapter of a run is never saved
